description: For work authorization, this checklist records authorized task boundary, inclusions, exclusions, budget code, schedule dates, quality hold points, and interfaces. Its supporting evidence includes approved drawings, permit status, readiness inspection, coordination record, and required training evidence.

blocks.guidance: Link this work authorization record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture contract package, work area, responsible crew, predecessor completion, permits, submittals, and access window for this work authorization.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify contract package, work area, responsible crew, predecessor completion, permits, submittals, and access window for this work authorization record.
sections.title: Checkpoint Reference

blocks.guidance: For work authorization, record authorized task boundary, inclusions, exclusions, budget code, schedule dates, quality hold points, and interfaces.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Required Inputs

blocks.guidance: Verify the work authorization condition before marking.
items: Tie notice-to-proceed release to the controlling scope exhibit and revision
Confirm workface planning, predecessor turnover, constraint removal, and crew mobilization
Reconcile procurement release, material staging, approved submittals, and fabrication status
Identify cost code, committed budget, allowance draw, and added-work spending ceiling
Schedule owner outage, utility isolation, access escort, and occupied-space coordination
Set inspection hold points, concealed-work release, benchmark, and turnover deliverable
blocks.label: Work Authorization Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Reconcile unchecked work authorization items before release.
items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority
blocks.label: Work Authorization Repeatable Checklist

blocks.guidance: Pair each work authorization result with a finding.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Do not release work with missing permits, unresolved design conflicts, unsafe access, unavailable controls, or exceeded authority. Do not release affected work authorization work.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Stop and Review Boundary

blocks.guidance: Close work authorization exceptions with verification.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Exception and Corrective Action

blocks.guidance: Keep work authorization controls until authorized release.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Escalation Record

blocks.guidance: State work authorization limits, assumptions, and access gaps.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Limitations and Interpretation

fields.label: Work Authorization Correction Verification and Release Notes

blocks.guidance: For work authorization, connect the correction to approved drawings, permit status, readiness inspection, coordination record, and required training evidence; name the release decision and retained work authorization limitation.
blocks.label: Work Authorization Correction Verification and Release Notes

sections.guidance: Verify work authorization conditions, control exceptions, and preserve release evidence.
sections.title: Checklist Conditions, Exception, and Release

subtitle: Work Authorization Checklist: construction work authorization and release using contract package, authorized task boundary, and approved drawings.
title: Work Authorization Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during construction work authorization and release when the work authorization record must identify contract package, work area, responsible crew, predecessor completion, permits, submittals, and access window. Complete the applicable handoff for authorization signatures, release conditions, field distribution, start record, and change-control linkage.
